div.div: مَحِيصٌ [an inf. n.: (see 1:) and also a n. of place, signifying A place to which one turns away, or aside; to which one flees; a place of refuge:] syn. مَحِيدٌ (S, K) and مَعْدِلٌ (Msb, K) and مَمِيلٌ (K) and مَهْرَبٌ. (S, K.) You say, مَا عَنْهُ مَحِيصٌ [There is no turning away, &c., or no place to which to turn away, &c., from it]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
